subject: Status: repro done, variance wins hold, one scope boundary
body:
Hi both,

Repro status: done for Section 7.1 and the first two columns of Table 1, using paper_experiments.ipynb as the harness. The learned couplings from both gadgets beat the baseline couplings in coupling_util on counterfactual-estimate variance in our reruns - Gadget 2's advantage is largest exactly where the mechanism distributions are least uniform, matching the paper's story. Training was stable; the only surprise was how sensitive Gadget 1 is to temperature initialization, which Wei documented in the shared config notes.

Scope boundary to confirm: the last two Table 1 columns and the Section 7.3 experiments rely on the companion implementation from the second repository, which we deliberately did not port. Emeka's API therefore exposes Gadget 1 and Gadget 2 only. Fine for the pilot, but the review slide should say so explicitly so nobody expects the full table.

API integration is tracking to 6/5. Privacy request went to Kofi's queue 5/14.

Giannis
